about: RC1 replay protection (hub-payment-privacy §2.1 PAY-R2, PAY-R3, PAY-R8; §4.2.5; core CORE-K16): a signed request is accepted once by its signer's X-ANet-TS, not by its signature. A time accepted before is 401 replayed, whatever was signed with it; a time at or below the signer's floor (here: signed before the hub started) is 401 ts_stale, with the floor in X-ANet-TS-Floor and as the member floor; both only after the signature verified, so a bad signature at the floor is 401 unauthorized without a floor.

cases.name: a time accepted before is replayed, whatever it signs

body.error: This signed request was already used; sign a new one.

cases.name: a time at or below the floor is ts_stale with the floor

body_has.error: The signing time is not after this hub's record for this signer; sign again with a later time (see X-ANet-TS-Floor).

cases.name: a bad signature at the floor is unauthorized, without a floor
